# corpus-full-featured

Exercises every optional field of the v2 schema: cross-repo spec ref,
inert legacy `vk_version`, enforced `fr_version`, rework lineage
(`parent_plan` / `prior_rework`), `origin_items` with a compound track,
a completed phase with observed PRs, a dependent phase with mixed step
states (ticked, skipped-with-note, open), and a manual tail phase.
